## Content Repurposing Engine v2 (Self-Evaluating Agent)

**Webhook:** POST /repurpose
**Body:** { script_id: 'recXXX' }

**Pipeline:**
1. Fetch script + System_Learnings + Brand Voice DNA
2. Generate 7 variations (3 hooks, 2 lengths, 2 angles)
3. **Self-evaluate** each variation on 5 criteria (1-10)
4. If any variation scores < 7 avg, **auto-retry** with specific feedback
5. Merge strong (first pass) + improved (retry) variations
6. Store in Airtable + Slack notify

**Anti-generic rules:** Banned phrases, unique psychological triggers per hook
**System Learnings:** Pulls proven patterns from past campaigns
**Brand Voice:** Ensures all variations match brand DNA
